objective.name: sandbox.dsl.switch.remote.meaning
objective.description: Use remote meaning.query and a DSL switch to choose the terminal route.

#root.role: Refresh the remote meaning projection, query one remote element, then use >switch on the selected remote name to choose the terminal wrapper route.

effects.remote_projection_refresh: The remote meaning projection is refreshed before selection.
effects.remote_projection_query: One remote projected element is selected.
effects.switch_terminal_route: The terminal route is chosen by a DSL switch over the selected remote value.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local DSL request becomes one branch-specific terminal response after a remote projected discovery feeds a DSL switch.
invariants: The flow refreshes and queries the remote projection before evaluating the DSL switch.
Exactly one terminal route is selected between the explicit case branch and the default branch.
success: On success, the terminal payload is the payload returned by the branch selected by the DSL switch.
When the selected remote name is sandbox.echo, the terminal route is the remote wrapper branch.
failure: The flow fails if the remote rebuild, remote query, or selected terminal route cannot complete.
Inter-instance reflective routing errors close the scenario fail-closed.
notes: This scenario is the primary N7 switch oracle over remote projected meaning.
It complements the if-based branch scenarios by exercising the switch/default runtime path.
